parts.official_mark_scheme_text:

parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: Estimated mean $131.9$ minutes; estimated standard deviation $11.7$ minutes.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Midpoints $110.5,125.5,133,140.5,153$ (B1 for at least four correct, in a table or formula). Mean $=\frac{18(110.5)+48(125.5)+34(133)+32(140.5)+18(153)}{150}=131.9$ (M1 for correct midpoint formula, allowing midpoints $\pm0.5$ and one midpoint error within class; A1 for identified 131.9, also accept 132, $131\frac9{10}$ or $\frac{1319}{10}$). Variance $=\frac{18(110.5)^2+48(125.5)^2+34(133)^2+32(140.5)^2+18(153)^2}{150}-(\text{their }131.9)^2=137.54$ (M1 appropriate variance formula with their five midpoints within classes, not bounds/widths/densities/frequencies/cumulative frequencies; condone one error). Standard deviation $=11.7$ (A1), accept $11.7277448\ldots$ to at least 3 s.f. or $11.6\leq\sigma<11.95$ www; if M0, SC B1 for this interval, www.
Total [5]
